subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose raw token, cost, quota-window, and freshness/source metadata by extending `session_status.details.usage`, or should it add a separate agent-facing usage tool/API?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but the response schema, privacy boundary, quota-window semantics, and source/freshness contract are maintainer-owned API decisions.

options.title: Extend `session_status.details`
options.body: Add a stable `details.usage` payload to the existing tool while preserving the rendered status card and current session visibility checks.

options.title: Create a separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and add a narrower agent-facing usage query backed by gateway/transcript usage code.

options.title: Keep status display-only
options.body: Leave raw usage behind gateway/UI/CLI surfaces and document that agents should not consume raw usage through `session_status`.

recommendation.title: Extend `session_status.details`
recommendation.body: Add a stable `details.usage` payload to the existing tool while preserving the rendered status card and current session visibility checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available routing owner from prior `session_status` and provider-usage history and prior review context.
